findings.rule: 277-c2 and honest copy (I.1): the '!' row means the requirement we will ask about next
findings.trigger: Answer the quick question ('Not yet', or 'Yes, regularly' with detail), let Tailoring finish, then press Back from Tailored to Job analyzed. The stakeholder row still shows the amber '!' marker, 'Not clear yet' and 'Not clear in your resume. We'll ask you next.'. But asksQuestion is false, so 'Tailor my resume' goes straight to Tailoring and no question is asked. The row keeps unclear = (requirement id == gap.question.requirementId) and never checks application.quickAnswer.
findings.title: Unclear row still promises the quick question after the user has answered it
findings.proof: JobResultViewModelTest: seed ResultTestData.application(quickAnswer = QuickAnswer(STAKEHOLDER_ID, "NOT_YET", "")) and assert that no row has unclear, and that the stakeholder marker is GAP.

findings.rule: 277-c9 and data integrity: the stored keywordCoverage must stay consistent with the stored tailoredResume
findings.trigger: On an application that already has a tailoredResume (tailored once after Skip this, then Back from Tailored to Job analyzed, then Tailor my resume, then Quick question), Continue or Skip calls KeywordCoverageCalculator.compute(gap.matches, answer, null). That writes keywordCoverage.final = null (the coverageFinal column) while tailoredResume is still stored. If the new run then fails or the user backs out of Tailoring, the application keeps a tailored resume with no final coverage. Passing current.tailoredResume keeps 'final' unchanged.
findings.title: Storing the quick answer clears the final coverage of an already tailored application
findings.proof: QuickQuestionViewModelTest: seed an application with a non-null tailoredResume, onPick(A_FEW_TIMES) then onContinue(), and assert that stored().keywordCoverage?.final equals KeywordCoverageCalculator.compute(matches, answer, tailoredResume).final (it is currently null).

findings.rule: D61 'old rows still decode'; review checklist item 5 (assertions check behaviour)
findings.trigger: analysisStoredBeforeTheFieldsExistedStillReads only round-trips a model with question = null through asDto/asExternalModel. It never decodes stored JSON that lacks the 'reason' and 'question' keys. If the '= null' defaults on RequirementMatchDto.reason or GapAnalysisDto.question were removed, the test would still pass, while every row saved before this PR would fail to decode (MissingFieldException in TmrJson).
findings.title: The 'old rows still decode' test does not decode an old row
findings.proof: In core/database JsonConvertersTest, decode a GapAnalysisDto JSON string without 'reason' and 'question' keys and assert that both are null.
